app.name: TickTack
app.tagline: Plan the day you mean to have.
app.splashLabel: TickTack, plan the day you mean to have. Loading.

states.errorBody: We couldn't load this screen. Your data is safe on this device.
states.comingSoon: This screen arrives in the next build.

today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Choose what fits today. Add a task to shape your day.
today.allDone: Everything planned for today is done.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.emptyBody: Nothing is scheduled on this day yet.
calendar.emptyWeekBody: Nothing is planned for these seven days yet.

goals.title: Goals
goals.emptyBody: Set a goal with milestones and watch your progress grow.

routines.title: Routines
routines.emptyBody: Build a short routine for your mornings or evenings.

me.title: Me
me.guestBody: Your plans stay on this device. Create an account later to sync them.
me.conceptNote: Built to show how VIZAM designs apps. Any demo data is synthetic.
me.guestAccountBody: Create an account to back up and sync your plans. Everything you made as a guest is kept.
me.signOutBody: Your plans are removed from this device. They stay in your account.
me.signOutPending_one: {{count}} change has not reached your account yet and will be lost if you sign out now.
me.signOutPending_other: {{count}} changes have not reached your account yet and will be lost if you sign out now.

tasks.openHint: Opens the task to edit it

editor.titlePlaceholder: What do you want to do?
editor.seriesNote: This task repeats. When you save, choose whether the change applies to this day only, this and the following days, or every occurrence.
editor.deleteBody: It will be removed from all your devices.
editor.orphans_one: {{count}} changed occurrence no longer fits the new schedule and will be removed.
editor.orphans_other: {{count}} changed occurrences no longer fit the new schedule and will be removed.

errors.dateRequiredForRepeat: Pick a date to start repeating from.
errors.dateRequiredForTime: Pick a date before setting a time.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
errors.repeatInvalid: Check the repeat settings (pick at least one day).
errors.saveFailed: The task could not be saved. Try again.
errors.goalInvalid: Give the goal a name (up to 120 characters).

editor.goalEmpty: No goals yet. Name one to link this task to it.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.previewNone: No upcoming dates with these settings.
repeat.needsDate: Pick a date first to repeat a task.

auth.signUpBody: Keep your plans safe and in sync.
auth.resetBody: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.
auth.unavailable: Accounts are not available in this build. Your plans stay on this device.
auth.guestMerge_one: {{count}} plan on this device will be added to your account.
auth.guestMerge_other: {{count}} plans on this device will be added to your account.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match. Try again or reset your password.
errors.signUpFailed: We could not create that account. If you already have one, sign in instead.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.requiresRecentLogin: For your security, enter your password again.
errors.unavailable: This is not available right now.

onboarding.step1Title: Plan the day you mean to have
onboarding.step1Body: Choose what fits today and see how full your day is before it starts.
onboarding.step2Body: Short morning and evening routines, ticked off step by step.
onboarding.step3Body: Link tasks to goals and watch the progress add up.
onboarding.readyBody: Start as a guest: everything stays on this device. Create an account any time to sync your plans.
onboarding.guestNote: Guest plans are kept and uploaded when you create an account.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.subtitle: This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.body: Your account, every plan stored in it and the data on this device will be deleted. Enter your password to confirm it is you.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Your account and all your plans will be permanently deleted.
